title: 第47章 张靓影
content_zh:
第47章 张靓影-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

《画心》前奏中长达半分钟的“啦”声哼唱，并非无意义的即兴创作。

这就像法师施法之前咏唱。

无咏唱施法固然能够节省时间。

可在施法之前咏唱，更有逼格和代入感。

哼唱部分也是一样。

电影《画皮》本就带有浓厚的神秘色彩，主题曲同样如此。

魏沐闭上眼睛，清唱声轻轻漫出：“啦啦啦啦啦啦.....”

没有乐器铺垫，只有纯粹的嗓音在空气中流转。

起初像狐妖小唯藏在夜色里的叹息，带着几分迷茫与缥缈。

进入到第三排歌词，又添了几分执拗，像是对人心的追问，最后则是进入怅然，就像电影诠释的主题人妖殊途.....

陈佳上原本微蹙的眉头渐渐舒展，敲击桌面的手指忘了落下。

直到清唱收尾，空气安静了两秒，他才猛地拍手：“就是这个！！”

之前的疑惑烟消云散，取而代之的是激动。

“我觉得把这几句放在开头会更好！！”

“电影开头？”

跟在身边的联合导演高林豹，马上反应过来。

“对！！”

魏沐闻言一愣，我就唱了一嗓子怎么就说到改电影？

他看过原版《画皮》，电影开头确实用了“声音前置”，专业术语叫“听觉先行设计”

只不过原版是纯音乐。

按照陈佳上的意思，是想把哼唱放到开头。

他对此没什么意见。

稍微改动一点音乐，并不会对电影本身造成重大影响。

《画皮》能大爆，靠的是优秀的演技以及曲折的故事情节，其他都是锦上添花，包括音乐。

之前就说过，两位女主角撕逼不停，从电影开拍一直撕到电影下映。

在拍摄期间，两位女主也较着劲。

一开始，还没变成大如的周训靠着天赋压着赵微打，后来赵微靠着一股狠劲慢慢居上，两个人在电影里贡献不错的演技。

反观陈琨....中规中矩吧，他这个角色本来就不讨好。

就和胡哥演《神话》一样，不仅被赵高爆锤演技，还要被追着骂。

其实老胡自己都想骂，实在是角色太煞笔。

坐在远处一直观察局面的宋柯，满意的点点头。

魏沐的表现再次出乎他的预期。

他的创作能力太强，还是一个新人，潜力无穷。

老实说，最初宋柯只是想碰碰运气，不行就不行，反正也不会损失什么。

没想到面对这种命题作文，他还能表现这么好。

陈佳上和高林豹热烈讨论，最后不忘了魏沐。

“等你写完歌词，我会通知藤原育郎，喊他来京城，我们就在京城把《画心》录完。”

“好。场地和器材我这边来安排。”

“谢谢宋老板。”

The half-minute long "la" humming in the prelude of "Painting Heart" is not a meaningless improvisation.

It's like a mage chanting before casting a spell.

Casting without chanting certainly saves time.

You can chant it before casting the spell, which makes it more powerful and immersive.

The same goes for the humming part.

The movie "Painted Skin" already has a strong sense of mystery, and so does the theme song.

Wei Mu closed his eyes and sang a cappella softly: "La la la la la la..."

There are no musical instruments, just pure voice flowing in the air.

At first it was like the sigh of the fox demon Xiao Wei hidden in the night, with a bit of confusion and mistiness.

Entering the third row of lyrics, a bit more stubbornness is added, like questioning the human heart, and finally it enters into despair, just like the theme of the movie interpretation of "human monsters have different paths..."

Chen Jiashang's originally slightly frowned brows gradually relaxed, and he forgot to tap his fingers on the table.

It wasn't until the a cappella song ended and the air was quiet for two seconds that he suddenly clapped his hands: "This is it!!"

The previous doubts disappeared and were replaced by excitement.

“I think it would be better to put these sentences at the beginning!!”

"The beginning of the movie?"

Co-director Gao Linbao, who was following him, reacted immediately.

"Yes!!"

Wei Mu was stunned when he heard this, and I sang aloud. Why did I talk about changing the movie?

He has seen the original version of "Painted Skin". "Sound pre-production" was indeed used at the beginning of the film. The technical term is "auditory first design".

It’s just that the original version is pure music.

According to Chen Jiashang, he wanted to put humming at the beginning.

He was fine with that.

A slight change to the music would not have a major impact on the film itself.

The success of "Painted Skin" relies on excellent acting skills and a twists and turns of the storyline. Everything else is the icing on the cake, including the music.

As I said before, the two heroines kept fighting each other from the time the movie started until the movie was released.

During the filming, the two heroines also competed with each other.

At the beginning, Zhou Xun, who had not yet become Da Ru, relied on his talent to overpower Zhao Wei. Later, Zhao Wei relied on his fierceness and gradually overtook him. The two of them contributed good acting skills in the movie.

On the other hand, Chen Kun... is pretty good, his character is not flattering in the first place.

Just like Hu Ge's performance in "The Myth", not only was Zhao Gao criticized for his acting skills, but he was also chased and scolded.

In fact, Lao Hu himself wanted to scold him because the character was really too bad.

Song Ke, who was sitting in the distance and observing the situation, nodded with satisfaction.

Wei Mu's performance once again exceeded his expectations.

His creative ability is too strong, and he is still a newcomer with endless potential.

To be honest, Song Ke just wanted to try his luck at first. If it didn't work, it wouldn't work. Anyway, he wouldn't lose anything.

I didn't expect that he could perform so well when faced with this kind of proposition composition.

Chen Jiashang and Gao Linbao had a heated discussion and finally did not forget Wei Mu.

"When you finish writing the lyrics, I will notify Ikuro Fujiwara and ask him to come to the capital, and we will finish recording "Painting Heart" in the capital."

"Okay. I'll arrange the venue and equipment."

"Thank you, Boss Song."
